## Summary and reason

What changed, and why is it needed? Link the relevant issue or implementation plan and cite applicable requirement or invariant IDs.

## Scope and affected boundaries

Describe what is in and out of scope. Identify affected modules, data ownership, transaction or asynchronous boundaries, and contract or migration implications. Address financial invariants, security controls, and concurrency when relevant.

## Verification and skipped checks

List the commands or reviews run with their results. Explain any skipped relevant checks and the follow-up owner.

## Risks, compatibility, and reviewer focus

Call out primary risks, compatibility or rollout concerns, rollback or forward-recovery limits, and the highest-risk area reviewers should examine.
